subject: Scheduled CSV export stalls above 10,000 rows

thread.author: Maya / Northwind
thread.message: Our weekly account export remains in preparing after about two minutes. We can export a 500-row sample, but the September account rollup includes around 14,800 rows. The scheduled report is due to finance tomorrow; the dashboard remains usable.

thread.author: Support / Elena
thread.message: A pagination cursor can expire during large exports. Please retry with a new scheduled run after clearing the old pending job. We have requested the worker trace for the failed run and asked engineering to confirm the timeout setting.

thread.author: Maya / Northwind
thread.message: The small test worked, but the full account export stalled again after the new run was created. Splitting the report by region is a temporary workaround, not a verified fix. I will test the proposed worker configuration tomorrow morning.

thread.author: Support / Elena
thread.message: No full-size verification result yet. Next shift should ask Maya for the 14,800-row test result and keep the engineering timeout question linked. Last customer update promised a response by 12:00 UTC.

next_action: Ask customer to verify the full-size export; engineering to confirm timeout setting.
